name: postgresql
description: PostgreSQL 17 server at <project>.<domain> — install it several times, one database server per project. Interactive install: database, user, password, and how clients connect: by hostname on the shared TLS port 5432 (SNI, libpq/psql 17+ with sslnegotiation=direct), on a dedicated public TCP port (any client), or both. Data lives in a host folder named after the project. Open the port(s) in your firewall.
